chunks: Ja'far, from Anbasah, from Jabir, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said:

Indeed, Allah, Exalted is His Remembrance, when He intends the demise of the dominion of a people, commands the celestial sphere to accelerate its movement, and it proceeds according to the measure of what He intends.

key_terms.دَوْلَةِ: Dominion, state, or era of power
key_terms.عَزَّ ذِكْرُهُ: Exalted is His Remembrance (a divine attribute)

ai.seo_question: How does the acceleration of the heavens signal the end of a people's dominion in Shia theology?
ai.summary: In Shia cosmology, this hadith from Al-Kafi illustrates the metaphysical link between celestial mechanics and terrestrial history, where the acceleration of the 'Falak' (celestial sphere) serves as a divine precursor to the decline of a specific dominion. Scholars interpret this as evidence of the universe's responsiveness to God's will, where cosmic movements are not merely physical but carry the weight of historical destiny, signaling that the end of an era is decreed before its actual manifestation.
